sentences.text: According to the allegation against him, he is said to have raped his own niece and thereafter injured her by sprinkling acid on her.
6. Though, nobody has seen the occurrence but the conviction has been recorded on the basis of strong circumstances against him.

7. The Doctor has found that histo-pathological examination of vaginal swab reflected presence of dead spermatozoa and RBC, justifying an inference that the deceased was subjected to sexual intercourse.

The cause of death was opined to be the shock Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.328 of 2019(4) dt.18-09-2023 hemorrhage as a result of injury suffered by her as also due to asphyxia because of suffocation and pressure on her neck.

8. Considering the circumstances against the appellant, we are not inclined to suspend his sentence during the pendency of the appeal, notwithstanding the fact that he has remained in jail for eight years.
9. The prayer for suspension of sentence is rejected.
10. However, looking at the period of custody of the appellant, we deem it appropriate to direct for an early hearing of this appeal.
11. The Registry is directed to prepare the paperbook with utmost dispatch and get this case listed in 3rd week of October, commencing from 16 th of October, 2023.

(Ashutosh Kumar, J)
